notes: Page 88. Top lines finish ¶፳፩ of Day 21 (Abba John, bishop of Jerusalem): Ge'ez joins p87 'ዘሀገረ፡' + 'ምስር' (with space); Amharic joins p87 'በእውቀ' + 'ታቸው' (no space) = በእውቀታቸው (so the p87 guess 'በእውቀት' was wrong). ¶፳፪-፳፭ finish the story; ¶፳፭ is the doxology and closes Day 21 (no arke on this page for John). '* * *' then Day 22 opener ¶፩ (Ge'ez 'አመ ፳ወ፪ ለጥቅምት'; Amharic 'ጥቅምት ሃያ ሁለት'): St Luke the evangelist (¶፩-፫, continues p89). Ge'ez ¶፳፫ numeral and ¶፳፬ numerals read from scan (small dotted glyphs) and inferred from sequence. Uncertain readings (check PDF): Ge'ez 'እሙንቱስ' (ሰ?), 'ወእምገዚ' (ወእምዝ?), 'ኀቢአ' twice (ገቢአ? scan glyph looks like ኀ), 'መናብርቲሆሙ' (line break መናብር|ቲሆሙ), 'እምዓማ፡ገንተ' (unclear), 'ይሐሩ' (ይሑሩ?), 'ይምሐረን' (doxology variant), 'ተሀል' (ትኩን?), 'ዘዘከሮሙ', 'በኵሉ' (scan glyph ዥ-like, written ኵ).
